title: Post-Variational Quantum Neural Networks on a Hybrid HPC-QC System
problem: Training quantum neural networks on NISQ devices with limited resources
motivation: NISQ devices are limited; post-variational methods reduce circuit evaluations
method: Post-variational quantum neural networks use a hybrid classical-quantum approach to avoid repeatedly running the quantum circuit. Instead of the variational method's approach of measuring the quantum circuit many times to estimate parameter updates, this method uses the classical computer to compute how to improve parameters differently—handling expensive calculations that would normally require repeated quantum measurements. This reduces the demand on the quantum hardware, making training feasible on small, noisy quantum devices (NISQ devices).
key_novelty: It trains quantum neural networks on resource-limited quantum computers with better accuracy than variational methods, without needing to repeatedly evaluate the quantum circuit.
limitations: Limited by NISQ device noise and qubit count
